summary: The diff implements REQ-8 comprehensively: App.tsx now defines both /match/$matchId/stats and /player-stats routes; MatchStatsPage.tsx reads match data from localMatchStore, computes batting/bowling stats via matchStats utilities, renders tabbed tables with all expected columns, and handles empty/invalid states; PlayerStatsPage.tsx loads all matches from localMatchStore, uses cumulativePlayerStats utility, provides team/player filtering, and shows an empty-state message when no matches exist; matchStats.ts and cumulativePlayerStats.ts implement the stat computation utilities with all required columns (runs, balls faced, strike rate, wickets, overs, economy rate). No significant missing requirements or hallucinated features are detected.
